text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae and Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan Sensei! Teach us how to get<n>more
Umazings!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh come on, you don't have to call me<n>that! ♪
But okay, I can tell you both a<n>thing or two.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Look for interesting things that people<n>can't stop
looking at!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Put yourselves in the shoes of your fans,<n>and think
of things that they'll want to<n>keep their eyes on!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So for an Umadol... That could be<n>practice
videos! Maybe they'd want to<n>see my prep for the
next concert!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If they see how hard I'm working every<n>day, they'll
end up wanting to see me<n>live even more!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
What would fans of a Tomakomai local<n>idol want
to see...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Maybe the town ramen shop rankings?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'll throw in my own bowl reports with<n>the
rankings. That should keep people<n>coming back!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
People will flock to Tomakomai from all<n>over just
to try the local delicacies, and<n>to think that it
might all be thanks to<n>ramen!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeah, I think it'd be hard to keep eyes<n>off of
that, so sounds good! ☆ Surprising<n>and new ideas
are also a driving force<n>behind Umazings! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: If that sounds good, then off I go!
